# Vanta Tweaks

> Windows apps that tune a gaming PC: the BIOS, Windows and the network. Start with the free PC Check, which only reads
> your PC and shows what's slowing your games down.

## Apps

- [PC Check](https://github.com/vanta-tweaks/download/releases/latest/download/VantaPCCheck.exe): free. Scores your
  Windows setup, network and BIOS, and tells you whether BIOS Tuner works on your PC. Changes nothing.
- [BIOS Tuner](https://vantatweaks.com/bios-tuner): tunes hidden BIOS settings for your exact CPU and board, with three
  presets (Safe, Recommended, Max). Shows every change first, saves a backup and restores it in one click. Works on
  desktop PCs with an AMI BIOS (most ASUS, MSI, Gigabyte and ASRock boards), not on most laptops.
  Prices (EUR, VAT included): 1 month 8, 3 months 12, 1 year 20, lifetime 30. One key, one PC.
- Coming later: Windows Tuner, Network Tuner, GPU Tuner, game packs.
